tools.name: find_component
tools.description: Finds the component for a UI need described in plain words, ranked, and says when this catalog ships nothing on purpose because the phone's own control is the right choice. Omit `need` to list every component with its purpose and whether it renders the real system control.

tools.name: get_component
tools.description: Everything needed to write a correct call site for one component: props with types, defaults and allowed values, what draws on iOS and on Android, the providers it needs at the app root, its dependencies, and the runtime rules that stop it rendering blank.

tools.name: check_snippet
tools.description: Scans TSX that uses these components for the mistakes that render nothing with no error: animated opacity on glass, the flex: 1 collapse, a clipped lens, a conditionally mounted surface. A read-only text scan, not a guarantee; verify_app checks a whole emitted project.

tools.name: get_app_setup
tools.description: How an app is set up so these components work and follow its theme, one topic at a time: the app-root proviRead these before writing animation or layout code against any glass component.

tools.name: get_provider_tree
tools.description: The exact app-root provider nesting these components require, in the order that works. Getting this wrong fails at runtime, not at compile time. Optionally pass the components you are using to see which providers they each need.

tools.name: get_theme_tokens
tools.description: The theme system: which hooks to call, and the spacing, radius and typography scales. Reference token names rather than hex values so a retheme propagates.

tools.name: check_snippet
tools.description: Paste TSX that uses these components and get back the glass-safety problems in it — the animated opacity, the flex:1 collapse, the clipped lens, the conditional mount. Read-only: it never touches your repo. A heuristic text scan, not a structural guarantee.
